title: Cheesy Hashbrown & Hamburger Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef (hamburger), browned and drained
instructions: Brown and drain ground beef; season with salt and pepper.
Mix together hashbrowns, browned beef, cream of mushroom soup, sour cream, and most of the cheddar cheese in a large bowl.
Spread mixture into a greased baking dish.
Top with remaining cheddar cheese and French fried onions.
Bake until heated through, bubbly, and topping is golden.
